offering_description.value: Distributes propane and related equipment and supplies to residential, commercial, industrial and agricultural customers and through portable-tank exchange. It buys propane from producers and suppliers, stores it, and delivers it by truck from retail distribution outlets.

primary_products.value: propane; propane tank exchange cylinders; propane appliances and equipment

primary_services.value: propane delivery; equipment installation and maintenance; wholesale propane supply

customer_segment.value: B2C: residential households using propane for heating, cooking and water heating, grill-cylinder buyers; B2B: commercial, industrial and agricultural customers, retailers carrying tank exchange, wholesale buyers

end_markets.value: residential heating; commercial and industrial fuel; agriculture; consumer recreation (grill cylinders)

revenue_model.value: product sales: propane sold by the gallon and cylinder exchanges, plus appliances and equipment; service fees: delivery, installation, tank rental and maintenance fees

value_chain_position.value: distributor: buys propane from producers and suppliers, sells to homes, businesses and retailers; asset operator: runs storage, trucks, cylinders and retail distribution outlets

geography_served.value: US national: Customers in all 50 states through retail outlets and tank exchange network

specialization.value: related lines: retail propane delivery, portable cylinder exchange, wholesale propane and related equipment sales

distribution_channels.value: own locations: retail distribution outlets with delivery trucks serving local customers; third-party retail: cylinder exchange displays at retailers such as grocery and home improvement stores; direct sales: commercial, industrial and agricultural accounts, wholesale
distribution_channels.category: own locations; third-party retail; direct sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Propane storage and transport subject to DOT/PHMSA safety rules, EPA environmental rules, and state propane codes
